$comment: REST routes this plugin registers outside the surfaces registry, each with the reason it stays REST-only. tests/test-self-test-manifest-test.php fails when a registered route is neither generated from a kit resource, covered by a manifest case, nor listed here. Paths are namespace-relative with URL parameters as {name}.

routes.extend-wp/v1/get-case-fields: wp-admin field-builder helper rendering form markup for the admin script; no non-browser use.
routes.extend-wp/v1/get-query-fields: wp-admin field-builder helper rendering form markup; no non-browser use.
routes.extend-wp/v1/get-php-code: wp-admin field-builder helper generating a PHP snippet for display; no non-browser use.
routes.extend-wp/v1/get-position-fields: wp-admin field-builder helper rendering form markup; no non-browser use.
routes.extend-wp/v1/awm-map-options: Google Maps browser configuration for the admin map field; a secret-bearing helper for the map script only.
routes.extend-wp/v1/modal-fields: renders the modal field form markup for the admin modal script.
routes.extend-wp/v1/modal-save: saves the modal field form for the admin modal script; the same values are reachable as content/meta through the content surfaces.
routes.extend-wp/v1/logs/diagnose: sends log context to the core AI client from the log viewer; an interactive admin feature, covered by the ai-abilities case when a provider is configured.
routes.extend-wp/v1/rest-health/openapi: generates an OpenAPI document for the REST-health page; download-only.
routes.extend-wp/v1/rest-health/test: runs one HTTP probe from the REST-health page; interactive.
routes.extend-wp/v1/rest-health/batch: runs a batch of HTTP probes from the REST-health page; interactive.
routes.extend-wp/v1/rest-health/history: per-route probe history for the REST-health page.
routes.extend-wp/v1/rest-health/monitor: monitor toggles for the REST-health page.
routes.extend-wp/v1/rest-health/monitor/payload: captured monitor payloads for the REST-health page.
routes.extend-wp/v1/self-test/cases: the self-test runner's own surface (moves to its package in Group C).
routes.extend-wp/v1/self-test/preview: the self-test runner's own surface (moves to its package in Group C).
routes.extend-wp/v1/self-test/run: the self-test runner's own surface (moves to its package in Group C).
routes.extend-wp/v1/self-test/cleanup: the self-test runner's own surface (moves to its package in Group C).
routes.extend-wp/v1/self-test/report: the self-test runner's own surface (moves to its package in Group C).
routes.ewp/v1/recently-seen/{id}: anonymous front-end view recorder for the recently-seen widget; deliberately public, no other surface makes sense.
routes.ewp-filter/{id}: front-end search results for one configured filter; covered by the search-filters case through its dynamic id.
